title: ALTO simulator mutates state while returning a command refusal
description:
set_preset applies NAME/M1POS before checking the configured refusal, then reports Error; DIMLEDS similarly changes state before rejecting. This undermines failure/rollback regression fidelity. Apply mutations only when accepted and assert rejected writes retain prior state. Source proof only, no simulator execution. Fixed and reverified by the linked repair task; source and runtime limits remain recorded there.
